evals.prompt: I want to interview my 89-year-old grandmother about her life before she passes, and eventually maybe put together something the whole family can read. Where do I even start?
evals.expected_output: Asks clarifying questions about publishing intent and any cognitive/age-related fragility before recommending a specific variant skill, and explains why it's routing to family-memory-deep-probe-reliability and/or dual-biography-interview-skill-v2 rather than the generic public kit by default.

evals.prompt: I just want to record my uncle telling the story of how he met my aunt, that's it, nothing bigger.
evals.expected_output: Recommends memory-elicitation-interview-skill rather than a full biography kit, explaining the scope mismatch a full-life interview would create.
